subject: QBR prep: Headcount prioritization & deputy approval path
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Headcount for Sep QBR — triage request
Attachments: QBR_headcount_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Team —

As we finalize the QBR packet next week I need a concise headcount ask from engineering leadership. Finance has signaled constrained incremental budget; we need to prioritize reqs so we present a clear ask to the exec team.

Asks:
- Send a ranked list of open reqs (top 5) by impact and urgency. Note any backfills that are mission-critical.
- Flag any reqs that must bypass the hiring freeze for regulatory or customer-SLA reasons.
- If you want a delegated (deputy) approval path for managers to open certain reqs, propose limits (time window, FTE cap).

Please populate the attached QBR_headcount_matrix.xlsx with team-level delta and individual req lines by Monday (2027-08-16 EOD). I will aggregate for the leadership packet.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure & Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount for Sep QBR — triage request
Attachments: req_list_draft.csv (csv)

Vivek —

Thanks, I pulled the initial slate and proposed a prioritization rubric in the attached. High-level suggestions:

1) Prioritization criteria (in order): customer SLA/regulatory impact > critical backfill (single-point-of-failure) > revenue acceleration > long-term platform/tech debt risk.
2) Temporary backfill freeze: recommend a 60-day backfill freeze for non-customer-facing roles; exempt groups: SRE (on-call coverage), Security, and active customer escalation owners.
3) Deputy approval flow: allow managers to greenlight postings for IC hires up to 0.5 FTE (internal cap) and <60 days to hire without exec sign-off. Anything above that needs director+ (or delegated deputy) approval and finance pre-clear.

I've attached req_list_draft.csv with my provisional top 7 and suggested disposition (approve / defer / freeze). Key calls: REQ-345 (ML Infra lead) and REQ-382 (SRE backfill) are time-sensitive.

If this approach looks OK, I will lock the deputy approval template and send to TA and Finance.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

> Vivek —
>
> Thanks, I pulled the initial slate and proposed a prioritization rubric in the attached. High-level suggestions:
> ...

Chloe — this aligns with my read. Quick notes from infra:
- Confirm REQ-345 (ML Infra lead) is approved — we need that slot to keep the compiler and kernel work on schedule (two releases impacted). I attached a short JD (REQ-345_JD.pdf).
- REQ-382 (SRE backfill) should be treated as exempt from freeze — we have two on-call gaps and it's already impacting mean time to recovery.
- For the deputy approval cap, +1: allow posting but require TA to route hire through a pre-defined JD template and a 2-week hiring window; if no offer within 2 weeks escalate to director.

I'll mark REQ-345 and REQ-382 as priority in our tracker and confirm cost centers by Monday.

Marcus

Finance update: incremental headcount dollars for Q3 are limited. We obtained approval for 3 net new FTEs across engineering, conditional on a signed headcount commitment and cost-center mapping before the QBR packet is finalized.

What TA needs from you to open the approved reqs:
- Finalized req IDs (which 3 to prioritize)
- Cost center codes and estimated salary band (send to Miya in Finance)
- Signed headcount commitment (DocuSign link below)

I will push the DocuSign envelope once Chloe confirms the three prioritized reqs and we confirm the TA owner.

Subject: Final: QBR headcount decisions & deputy approval rollout
Attachments: final_headcount_approval.pdf (pdf)

Team — thank you for the quick turns. Final decisions for the QBR packet: 

Approved (to be routed to DocuSign):
- REQ-345 (ML Infra lead) — approved (priority 1)
- REQ-382 (SRE backfill) — approved (priority 2)
- REQ-410 (Senior Backend — revenue-critical work) — approved (priority 3)

Disposition for others: defer non-customer-facing platform work until next fiscal window.

Deputy approval policy (effective immediately for this tranche): managers may request TA to post reqs for IC hires up to 0.5 FTE and hires estimated < $160k total comp without director-level sign-off. All postings must use the standardized JD template in the Drive folder and include a 2-week hiring window; TA will escalate if an offer is not extended in that period.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm cost centers & salary bands for the three approved reqs and add to the DocuSign envelope (due 2027-08-20 EOD).
- Laura/TA (Nicole): prepare DocuSign and TA requisitions once cost center data is in.
- Tessa: update the QBR matrix with final dispositions and attach final_headcount_approval.pdf to the packet.

Thanks — I will close the loop with Finance after DocuSign is sent.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
